assertions.assertion: CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The clinical indication is recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and capture potential arrhythmic events
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
CO-22 indicates that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
